name: caveman plugin
effect: terse replies; typically cuts reply tokens by a large share
install: Install the caveman plugin, then run /caveman. /ultracave is terser.
tradeoff: Terse replies can drop explanation you wanted. Switch it off with "normal mode" when you need detail.

name: caveman-compress
reduces: input tokens from CLAUDE.md and memory files
effect: shrinks the files that are read at the start of every session
install: Run /caveman-compress on CLAUDE.md. It keeps a readable backup next to the file.
tradeoff: Compressed text is harder to read and edit by hand.

name: RTK (Rust Token Killer)
effect: filters long command output before Claude reads it
install: Install rtk and add its PreToolUse hook for Bash in settings.json.
tradeoff: Filtered output can hide a line you needed; `rtk proxy <cmd>` shows the raw output.

name: Concise output style
effect: a standing style instruction for every reply
install: Set an output style in Claude Code settings (outputStyle) that asks for short answers.
tradeoff: A style applies to all work, including tasks where long answers are right.

name: Lower default effort
install: Set a lower effort level in settings, or turn Model Manager mode to auto so it picks effort per task.
tradeoff: Hard tasks can need more thinking; use the effort override for those.

name: CLAUDE.md reply rule
effect: one rule: answer first, no recap, no closing offer

detect.claude_md_matches: answer first|no recap|be terse|terse|concise replies|short answers

install: Add to CLAUDE.md: "Answer first. No recap, no closing offer. Keep code and numbers exact."
tradeoff: A rule is followed less strictly than a plugin that enforces a mode.
